questions.q: What dish is being cooked in the video?
questions.e: In the video: "Domaće ćufte u paradajz sosu" — homemade meatballs in tomato sauce.

questions.q: What are the meatballs fried in?
questions.e: In the video: "Obavezno ih pržim na masti sa obe strane dok ne porumene" — I always fry them in lard on both sides until they turn golden.

questions.q: What is added after the meatballs are taken out?
questions.e: In the video: "Zatim ih izvadim, a potom dodam brašno i alevu papriku" — then I take them out and add flour and ground paprika.

questions.q: What is the secret of any red sauce?
questions.e: In the video: "A tajna za svaki crveni sos je malo šećera" — and the secret of every red sauce is a little sugar.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: *Mlevenom* mesu dodamo crni i beli luk.
questions.e: Mleveno meso — minced meat; mleti — to grind.
Crni luk — onion (literally "black onion"), beli luk — garlic ("white onion").

questions.q: Pržim ih na masti dok ne *porumene*.
questions.e: Poruméneti — to turn golden-brown; rumen — rosy.

questions.q: Sve to lepo zamesimo i formiramo *kuglice*.
questions.e: Kuglica — a little ball; kugla — a ball.

questions.q: ___ mesu dodamo crni i beli luk.
questions.e: Dodati ("to add") requires the dative case for what is added to: mlevenom mesu.
Pour with what: instrumental case — vodom.
Direct object, inanimate, masculine: the accusative coincides with the nominative — sos.

questions.q: A tajna za svaki ___ sos je malo šećera.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with sos in the masculine singular: crveni sos.
